name: The periods screen shows each status with only its allowed actions
title: SC-13-11-05 The periods screen shows each status with only its allowed actions
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F2
And periods "Eylül 2026" CLOSED, "Ekim 2026" OPEN and "Kasım 2026" DRAFT exist
When the manager opens the periods page
Then each period shows its status label
And each row offers only the actions SC-13-11-04 accepts for that status
